correctness.rationale: The graphic-arrangement chambers correspond exactly to all noncyclic edge orientations. In the dual lattice, every oriented edge incidence matrix has the unique primitive signed cycle relation; total unimodularity proves the semigroup is saturated. The affine chart is the single circuit binomial, including the k=1 smooth eliminations. The Jacobian directly gives the reduced union of codimension-four ambient coordinate planes, thus pure n-4-dimensional projective singular locus; orientation counts and local orders give fixed-point multiplicities. The actual standalone checker verifies signed circuits, all spanning-tree incidence determinants and counts for n=3..8. No infinite claim relies on finite tests.

value.rationale: The cycle graphical zonotopes are a canonical, literature-studied family whose associated normal projective toric varieties have not been classified by the identified f-vector sources. The uniform every-chamber binomial chart presentation is a substantial structural statement and yields exact all-rank singular dimensions, changes in singular-locus geometry (n=3 smooth, n=4 isolated six conifolds, n>=5 positive-dimensional), local Hilbert--Samuel multiplicity distributions, and global local-complete-intersection geometry. These are motivated natural invariants, not an arbitrary finite slice or mere face-vector count.
